name: deployment
description: Consolidate the Deployment changes (image, env, mounts, volumes) of several release packages into one set of YAMLs for oc.deployment.
author: Aravinthan Selvaraj

arguments.name: release_directory
arguments.description: Folder of release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), applied in natural name order (H9 before H10). Give this or 'releases'.

arguments.name: releases
arguments.description: Release packages (ZIPs or extracted folders), applied in exactly this order. Give this or 'release_directory'.

arguments.name: output_directory
arguments.description: Where the consolidated YAMLs and consolidation-report.json are written; defaults to <workspace>/consolidated/deployment.

arguments.name: overwrite
arguments.description: Empty a non-empty output_directory first (otherwise such a folder is refused, so stale YAMLs are never applied).

outputs.name: output_directory
outputs.description: Folder with one consolidated DeploymentUpdate per Deployment; give it to oc.deployment as 'source' (folder mode). Complete resources are in its 'native' subfolder.

outputs.name: report
outputs.description: Path of consolidation-report.json: releases, targets, the release that last changed each item, and changes that cancelled out.

outputs.name: releases
outputs.description: Release names in the order they were applied.

outputs.name: targets
outputs.description: One entry per Deployment: name, file, native_file, releases and keys.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: True when at least one release changes a Deployment.
